beats.care: At JNU? The union says geysers should work in all hostels within two weeks, and school libraries open till 9 pm.
beats.what: After talks with a dean-led committee, JNU revoked five students' rustication and agreed to drop FIRs and proctorial inquiries.
beats.why: Students protested the rustications, UGC rules and poor hostels. JNU issued a notice, and meeting minutes record the deal.

cards.body: It followed a University General Body Meeting on October 1.
cards.caption: length of the hunger strike

cards.body: Committees to review the proctor's manual and consider bringing back the JNU entrance exam, structural audits of some hostels, and a possible 25% scholarship hike, still under consideration.
cards.title: What the union says was agreed

cards.body: The union says it isn't done: the protest continues until every promise is actually carried out.

opts: It checks if the promises are really carried out
cards.q: Why does the review after 14 working days matter?
cards.why: The union says the deal only counts if it's implemented, and the review is where that gets checked.

cards.q: Do hunger strikes work for students?

hook: What did a *17-day hunger strike* win JNU students?

learn.t: The five students got their rustication revoked, but they still have to pay their fines.
